title: Delaram - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Delaram in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Delaram is a light-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (C), Luck (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Delaram
sections.content:
Location: Stone Wave Cliffs.

Obtained from Stone Wave Cliffs.

sections.title: Is the Delaram Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (C), Luck (B). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
